recipe.title: High-Protein Chicken Pot Pie
recipe.summary: Creamy chicken and vegetables baked with six homemade Greek-yogurt protein drop biscuits.
recipe.story: Classic fall comfort food made lighter and higher in protein without pasta, heavy cream, canned soup, or pie crust.
ingredients: 2 pounds raw boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces
4 cups Kroger Frozen Mixed Vegetables with carrots, corn, green beans, and peas
2 cups Simple Truth Organic Chicken Bone Broth
1 cup Chobani Nonfat Plain Greek Yogurt

ingredient_sections.title: Chicken Pot Pie Filling
items: 2 pounds raw boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces
4 cups Kroger Frozen Mixed Vegetables with carrots, corn, green beans, and peas
2 cups Simple Truth Organic Chicken Bone Broth

ingredient_sections.title: Protein Biscuits
items: 1 cup Chobani Nonfat Plain Greek Yogurt

instructions: Lightly spray a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned.
During the final minute of cooking, add the granulated garlic, onion powder, salt, black pepper, and thyme. Stir until the chicken is evenly coated.
Add the frozen mixed vegetables and chicken bone broth. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Blend the cottage cheese until completely smooth, then stir it into the chicken and vegetables.
Whisk the cornstarch and cold water together. Stir the slurry into the skillet and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes, until thickened.
Transfer the filling to the prepared baking dish.
Mix the self-rising flour, Greek yogurt, and granulated garlic until a soft drop-biscuit dough forms.
Divide the dough into six equal portions and drop them evenly over the filling. Brush with melted butter.
Bake uncovered for 18 to 22 minutes, until the biscuits are golden, the filling bubbles, and the chicken reaches 165°F.
Rest for 5 minutes. Divide into six 1 1/2-cup servings with one protein biscuit each.
freezer_storage: Divide the remaining chicken pot pie into complete servings with one biscuit in each portion.
If four servings remain, use a gallon-size freezer bag. If fewer than four servings remain, use a quart-size freezer bag.
Remove as much air as possible without crushing the biscuits, seal, and freeze flat for up to 3 months.
reheating_instructions: Place one serving in an oven-safe dish. Cover and bake at 350°F until hot throughout.
Uncover during the final few minutes to help the biscuit regain its texture.
tips: The biscuits are drop biscuits and do not need shaping.
Blend the cottage cheese completely smooth before adding it to the filling.
